creator: bengusberg
title: Four-prompt sequence: ask ChatGPT/Claude for the fastest $10k/mo path based on your profile, find a real person doing it, build a <$100 30-day plan, then 'what do I do right now'

tools.name: ChatGPT
tools.detail: Use whichever model knows more about you (memory)

claims: Creator's result: sell AI training courses at $5k each; model named 'John and Bethany' as examples to study
Most people make a plan and never start; the fourth prompt forces a first action
Creator intro: Stanford founder, AI startup, raised $4 million
how_to_steps: Prompt 1: 'Based on everything you know about me, what's the fastest path to making an extra $10k/month? Requirements are (1) it has to be something I can start working on this weekend, (2) must take less than $100 to start, and (3) must be based on my actual skills.'

Prompt 2 (same chat): 'Find at least one person already making money in this exact way. Name them and link me to their profile. Then, break down in excruciating detail the exact step-by-step process they used to succeed so I can copy their playbook.'
Prompt 3: 'Based on everything you learned, write me a 30-day plan that costs under $100 to start and lands my first paying customer as quickly as possible. Tell me exactly what to do each day.'
Prompt 4: 'Ok - now we have the plan. What should I do right now to start?'
on_screen_only: Title card: 'Don't ask ChatGPT how to make money. Do this instead:'
Each of the four prompts shown as a screenshot in the ChatGPT composer (text transcribed in how_to_steps)
cta: Try it and let me know what you build; follow for more

relevance.why: Generic make-money prompting; a founder already building products gets little beyond prompt 2 (competitor/playbook teardown), which is a reasonable research pattern.

implement_score.why: Only prompt 2 and 3 are worth borrowing as a quick 'find who already does this and reverse-engineer their playbook' research step before building a new offer; otherwise skip.

verify: Models may hallucinate named people/profiles in prompt 2; verify any person cited
Depends on memory being enabled in ChatGPT/Claude
